finding: Native-activation conditioning gives PC+1 on each of these two fixed16 cases, SA unchanged; the sampled images are visually very similar. VP016 tool withdraws while insect stays on leaf; VP027 hands repeatedly press dough with limited visible shape change. This is limited support for the mechanism, not proof of broad visual or process gains. Whole H no-C control is better overall; do not use whole H as an accepted design.
scope: selected sampled frames, not a certification of all frames or all H cases
